data.body: OPERATOR DECISION (2026-08-19): An unknown/failed mapped project should SKIP-and-continue. The current fetcher.py:539-577 behavior (catch the per-project fetch error, emit fetcher-project-fetch-failed, log SKIPPING, continue the pass) is the INTENDED contract. This is NOT a product regression. RESOLUTION: correct the live rehearsal expectation — test_unknown_project_fails_closed must assert skip-and-continue (the pass proceeds; other mapped projects still reconcile), not fail-closed — and add a non-external test pinning skip-and-continue for an unknown mapped project. Verify/record the exact boundary (whether a single-project unknown mapping still fails closed) during implementation.
